Republic of Pirates Unique Fleet Commander. Gains 1 charge to use the Raiding Party Action for every 2 [icon:NAR_REW_PROMOTION] Promotions it has. Raiding Party: Targets an adjacent [icon:TREASURE_FLEET] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TREASURE_RESOURCES_TOOLTIP]Treasure Resource[/TIP] owned by a different Civilization in [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_DISTANT_LANDS_TOOLTIP]Distant Lands[/TIP]. This [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] instantly spawns a [icon:UNIT_TREASURE_FLEET] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TREASURE_CONVOY_TOOLTIP]Treasure Convoy[/TIP] under your control. This does not reset the turns until another [icon:UNIT_TREASURE_FLEET] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TREASURE_CONVOY_TOOLTIP]Treasure Convoy[/TIP] spawns.

Activate on an unoccupied tile adjacent to a Treasure Resource owned by a different Civilization in Distant Lands. This Settlement instantly spawns a Treasure Convoy under your Control, this does not reset the turns until another Treasure Convoy spawns.
Requires an adjacent and unoccupied Treasure Resource tile owned by a different Civilization in Distant Lands.
